notes.title: Gladiator's Arena: Top-down, rogue-lite, medieval combat
notes.notes: Gladiators Arena Live: A rogue-lite top-down game where you play as a gladiator wielding up to 7 different medieval weapons to combat hordes of enemies. Choose from various upgrades and abilities to craft unique builds.

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Balancing
notes.notes: Hey Players, thank you for the feedback! The game now is more balanced, some skills now stack, no more game crashing bugs. Thanks everyone
